scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run stamp:home-build-id && npm run verify:home-build-id
scripts.build:staging: tsc -b && vite build --mode staging && npm run stamp:home-build-id && npm run verify:home-build-id
scripts.build:perf-staging: VITE_API_SAME_ORIGIN=true tsc -b && VITE_API_SAME_ORIGIN=true vite build --mode staging && npm run stamp:home-build-id && npm run verify:home-build-id
scripts.build:same-origin: VITE_API_SAME_ORIGIN=true tsc -b && VITE_API_SAME_ORIGIN=true vite build && npm run stamp:home-build-id && npm run verify:home-build-id
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=xlist-dashboard --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:staging && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=xlist-dashboard-staging --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:same-origin: node -e "console.error('BLOCKED: same-origin production deploy requires explicit approval; follow docs/operations.md same-origin API runbook'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.build:ssr: npm run typecheck:functions && vite build && npm run stamp:home-build-id && npm run verify:home-build-id
scripts.build:e2e:waterfall: npm run build && npm run typecheck:functions && vite build --ssr functions/render-waterfall.tsx --outDir dist-ssr --emptyOutDir
scripts.test:e2e:waterfall: npm run build:e2e:waterfall && WATERFALL_E2E=1 playwright test e2e/waterfall-home.spec.ts
